name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Petererhof
beschreibung: The Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Petererhof in Thiersee is situated on the outskirts of the village with views of the Kaisergebirge mountains. The property operates as an active agricultural farm, giving guests the opportunity to meet the farm animals. The apartment is functionally furnished and accommodates up to four guests. The peaceful natural setting provides ideal rest and relaxation away from the bustling crowds.
